news.headline: Fed Holds Rates Steady, Signals Potential Cuts in Q3
news.summary: The Federal Reserve kept interest rates unchanged at 5.25-5.50% but signaled two potential rate cuts for Q3 2026, citing improving inflation outlook.

news.headline: NXTC Q2 Earnings Beat Estimates, Raises Full-Year Guidance
news.summary: Nexa Technologies reported Q2 earnings of $2.45 per share, beating consensus by 12%. Revenue grew 22% YoY. Company raised FY2026 guidance citing strong AI chip demand.

news.headline: TECH Unveils Next-Gen AI Processing Chip
news.summary: TechVentures announced its new Apex AI chip series with 40% performance improvement over previous generation. Production to begin Q4 2026.

news.headline: SEC Launches Inquiry into NXTC Options Timing
news.summary: The SEC has opened an inquiry into timing of NXTC executive stock option exercises ahead of positive earnings announcement. Company cooperating.

news.headline: CloudMajor Partners with TECH for Enterprise AI Solutions
news.summary: CloudMajor announces strategic partnership with TechVentures to integrate Apex AI chips into enterprise cloud offerings. Deal worth $2B over 3 years.

news.headline: Healthcare Spending Growth Remains Muted Despite Policy Changes
news.summary: Industry analysts report healthcare spending growth of 4% YTD, below historical averages. Policy uncertainty continues to impact capital expenditure plans.
